finding.text: The brief says the cause and the before/after counts go as a `log` line in this folder's `task.jsonl`, but the folder has no `task.jsonl`; the report lives only in `session.jsonl`. A fresh agent opening the folder won't find the file the brief names (requirements.md step 2 and 4), so write the cause (file:line) and the 0→0 / 0→1 numbers there.

The cause is stated as "stub-session lines" in `session.jsonl`, but there is no file:line for the demo page and call that wrote them, which step 2 required. The fix is a blanket guard in `WhisperLog.js:53` rather than a fix at the cause, and the caveat admits 13 `/framework/ext/drawer/` lines were not reproduced.

The guard silences every `navigator.webdriver` browser, including a real-mic test or headless run that should still log. The brief asked for "a demo or fake mic never writes, a real mic on any page still does". Only `test-whisper-log.mjs` opts in, so any other Playwright test that checks the log now sees nothing. Grep for other tests that read `bucket.jsonl` and give them the flag, or key the guard on the mic being fake.
`doc/demo.md:27` describes the file and its writer but not the new skip, so it is now incomplete next to `readme.md:7`. Add the same sentence there.
The `$WHISPER_LOG_FORCE` opt-in is a new global with no home in `WhisperLog.js`'s class comment (lines 25-30) beyond the one-line doc on `automated()`. It is fine but easy to miss.
The fallback writes in `ux/Dictate/Dictate.js:724,731` (`prompts.jsonl`) are not guarded. This is probably out of scope, but a smoke run could pollute that file the same way.
